title: Pushforward of the sheaf associated to a module along the spectrum of a ring map
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\psi=\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the induced morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with the pushforward of modules $\psi_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. For a $B$-module $N$ let $N_R$ be $N$ viewed as an $R$-module through $\varphi$, and let $\widetilde N$ on $\operatorname{Spec}B$, $\widetilde{N_R}$ on $\operatorname{Spec}R$ and the maps $\tau$ be as in [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. Then there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] $\pi_N:\psi_*\widetilde N\xrightarrow{\sim}\widetilde{N_R}$, natural in $N$, such that $\pi_N(\tau_{\operatorname{Spec}B}(n))=\tau_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(n)$ for every $n\in N$, where $\tau_{\operatorname{Spec}B}(n)\in\widetilde N(\operatorname{Spec}B)=(\psi_*\widetilde N)(\operatorname{Spec}R)$. In particular $\psi_*\widetilde N$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent].

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01I9 (lemma-widetilde-pullback), part (2): $\psi_*\widetilde N=\widetilde{N_R}$ functorially in $N$

mathlib_match.how: a few Mathlib declarations, one per clause, for φ : R ⟶ B in CommRingCat and N : ModuleCat B: (tilde N) is quasi-coherent (instance :465), so IsIso (tilde N).fromTildeΓ (isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent :850), hence IsIso ((pushforward (Spec.map φ)).obj (tilde N)).fromTildeΓ (isIso_fromTildeΓ_pushforward :568); its inverse is an isomorphism ψ_*Ñ ≅ (Γ(ψ_*Ñ, ⊤))~ where Γ(ψ_*Ñ, ⊤) = Γ(Ñ, ⊤) with R acting through φ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward_obj_obj, Sheaf.lean:170; pushforwardCompModulesSpecToSheafIso :544 shows the module structure is restrictScalars φ); composing with tilde of the R-linear inverse of tilde.isoTop N : N ≅ Γ(Ñ, ⊤) (:247, toOpen N ⊤ = τ, B-linear hence R-linear) gives π_N; π_N(τ_B(n)) = τ_R(n) because on ⊤ the inverse of fromTildeΓ is toOpen _ ⊤ (toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app :294 at U = ⊤) and tilde of a linear map commutes with toOpen (tilde.toOpen_map_app :226); naturality in N from fromTildeΓNatTrans (:313) and tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (:338); quasi-coherence is the instance :465 for N_R. Mathlib's tilde on Spec (CommRingCat.of R) is the sheaf of lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections (as recorded there).
